shared_elements: low-relief carving on a monolithic stone surface
horizontal band filled with repeated short parallel strokes
schematic, flat, outlined forms in shallow relief
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, strongly schematic relief organised into stacked horizontal zones, and both include a plain circular disc and a band filled with repeated short vertical strokes, which is the most specific correspondence. But A depicts a single monumental anthropomorphic figure (head, arms, hands, belt) with abstract emblems on its body, while B depicts registers of animals — a crouching quadruped, a bird-like creature and a snake — beneath arched motifs, with no human form at all.
